fullDescription: A ceremonial and organized asset management design system with a 'Red Noir' dark aesthetic, infused with warm spiritual accents like saffron and gold. Ideal for religious institutions, NGOs, and traditional organizations requiring robust resource tracking. Features include a bento grid for capabilities, a star-parallax background, glassmorphism dashboard elements, and high-contrast status labeling. Layout elements include a hero section with a badge, a stats horizontal strip, and a detailed asset tracking table with 'Active/Returned/Pending' statuses.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-mode management interface that blends spiritual ceremony with technical precision. It uses a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, vibrant reds (#ef233c), and warm golds (#d4a843) to convey both authority and devotion. The design centers around the lifecycle of assets (Issuance, Tracking, Return) using modern UI patterns like bento grids and animated border gradients.

style.description: The style is 'Spiritual Industrial' - combining the clean, data-heavy look of SaaS dashboards with ceremonial colors. Typography pairs Manrope (for bold, spiritual headings) and Inter (for clean, legible data). The palette relies on #000000 background with accents of #ef233c (Red), #f59e0b (Saffron), and #d4a843 (Gold). Micro-interactions include glowing pulse effects, conic-gradient spinning borders on primary buttons, and a subtle floating animation for floating cards.
style.prompt:
### Visual Theme
- **Base Color Palette**: Background: Deep Black (#000000) with subtle gradients to #1a0a05. Primary Accent: Red (#ef233c). Spiritual Accents: Saffron (#f59e0b) and Gold (#d4a843). Status Colors: Emerald (#10b981) for returned, Saffron for issued, Red for overdue.
- **Typography**: Headings use 'Manrope' (weights 600-800) with tight tracking (-0.05em). Body text uses 'Inter' (weights 300-500). Use all-caps for labels and small uppercase for sub-headers.
- **Background Effects**: Fixed background with two star-fields (stars-1: 1px, stars-2: 2px) animating vertically. Radial blurs of deep red and amber at 5% opacity. 40px grid overlay with radial mask.
- **Animations**: 
  - `fade-in-up`: 0.8s ease-out from 20px Y-offset.
  - `border-spin`: 2.5s linear infinite using `conic-gradient` on a 2px border-box.
  - `pulse-glow`: 2s ease-in-out for hover states on cards.
  - `float`: 6s ease-in-out translation of -8px.
- **Glassmorphism**: 60% opacity black backgrounds with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and `border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling landing page structure transitioning into a comprehensive data management dashboard view.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top header. Max-width 6xl. Background: black/60 with 20px backdrop blur. 1px white/10 border. Rounded-full. Left: 36px circular avatar with saffron border and temple branding. Center: text links in Zinc-400. Right: Log-in link and a 'Dashboard' button with an animated spinning conic-gradient border.

Centered layout. Top: Badge with a pulsing amber light and 'Seva' related messaging. Heading: Large (text-8xl) Manrope text with vertical white-to-gray gradient; highlight one keyword with a red accent and a saffron underline squiggle. Subtext: Max-width 2xl, Zinc-400. Buttons: One 'Shiny CTA' with red/gold border animation, one dark grey return button.

Full-width border-y strip. Background: white/[0.02]. 5-column grid. Each card has a large font-bold value and a small uppercase label (e.g., 'Total Assets', 'Pending Return'). On hover, show a 2px gold gradient underline.

7xl max-width. Header: Saffron 'Core Capabilities' pill. 4-card grid (1 large 2x2 card, 1 wide 2x1 card, 2 small 1x1 cards). Large card features an 'Issued Asset Preview' mockup showing active/returned items with edit icons. Cards use black backgrounds, 10% hover glow gradients (saffron/red/emerald), and 1px borders.

Two-column layout. Left: Feature list with 'feature-line' vertical gradient indicators. Right: Asset Issue Dashboard mockup. Mockup includes: 3 summary stats (Issued, Returned, Overdue), and a detailed data table. Table headers: Asset, Person, Issue Date, Return, Status (pill labels), and an Edit action button. Rows should alternate with subtle backgrounds.
Full-width high-contrast gradient background (Red to Gold). Text: Large 5xl bold Manrope in black. Center-aligned 5-star rating icon row. Subtext for person's name and title in black/70.

Divided into 3 sections: Branding/About, Platform Links, and Temple Links. Bottom features a massive 'text-stroke' watermark text (e.g., 'ORGANIZATION NAME') at 10vw size with 10% opacity. Copyright and social links in uppercase Zinc-600, 10px tracking.

special_ui_components.description: A button with a continuous spinning colorful border.
special_ui_components.prompt: Border-radius: 9999px. Padding: 1rem 2.5rem. Background: Black padding-box. Border: 2px transparent border-box. Gradient: `conic-gradient` spinning from 0deg to 360deg with colors #ef233c (5%) and #d4a843 (15%). Animation: `border-spin 2.5s linear infinite`. Inside: White text with an icon that translates X on hover.

special_ui_components.description: High-contrast small labels for item states.
special_ui_components.prompt: Font-size: 8px or 9px. FontWeight: Bold. Uppercase. Padding: 2px 6px. Background: 10% opacity of the theme color. Border: 1px solid 20% opacity of theme color. Colors: Saffron (#f59e0b) for 'Issued', Emerald (#10b981) for 'Returned', Red (#ef233c) for 'Pending/Overdue'.

Two layers of box-shadows on transparent divs. layer 1: 1px white stars; layer 2: 2px white stars. Animation: `animStar` moving from 0px to -2000px translateY. Durations: 50s and 80s respectively for parallax effect.

structured.special_notes: Must maintain the 'Sacred' tone in copywriting (using terms like Seva, Devotion, Sacred Items). Must use the specific accent red #ef233c against black for high-urgency items like 'Overdue' status. Do not use generic bright colors outside of the saffron/red/gold/emerald status palette. Ensure all dashboard mockups include a 'pencil/edit' icon for every record to emphasize management capability.
